Package com.saicone.nbt

Class TagType<T>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.TagType<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of object represented by NBT value.
public class TagType<T> extends Object
Define a tag type with associated object representation.
A tag type can be used to get common information about tags like ID, name, pretty name and size in bytes.
